cast.name: Kamala Harris

on_screen_text.text: Vice President Harris on the right to choose

spoken_summary: Kamala Harris discusses the issue of "Roe," stating that powerful forces have worked for years to eliminate it. She frames the issue as a fundamental right to privacy and self-determination to which all Americans are entitled. She asserts, "no politician...should be telling a woman what she should do with her own body," and that it is a woman's decision to make with her family, faith leader, or physician. She concludes with a call to action to stand up for a woman's right to choose and access to abortion.
audio_music: The audio consists solely of Kamala Harris's spoken words. There is no background music or sound effects.
editing_pacing: The video is a single, static talking-head shot with no cuts or camera movement.
central_claim: A woman's right to choose is a fundamental right of privacy and self-determination that politicians should not interfere with.
intended_effect: To persuade viewers to support abortion rights and mobilize them to defend a woman's right to make her own healthcare decisions.
